onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

error_onset_time.Description: The times of the error onset.

reward_start_time.Description: The times of the reward onset.

reward_stop_time.Description: The times of the reward offset.

movement_start_time.Description: The times of the hand sensor at the home-position off (= onset of the movement).

cue_onset_time.Description: The times of the target and go-cue instruction (reach target and go-cue were instructed simulatneously in this task).

target.Description: Defines whether the target was on the left or right side.

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
